terms_full.detail:
Article 1 (Service Overview)
UAT (Ultra AutoTrade, hereinafter referred to as the "Service") is a digital asset platform that utilizes AI technology to assist users with market analysis and strategy execution. The Service provides an environment where users can utilize digital assets through self-managed wallets. The Service does not guarantee any specific investment results, profits, or preservation of principal.

Article 2 (Non-Custodial Model)
The Service adopts a Non-Custodial model, meaning users maintain control over their own wallets and digital assets. The Company does not possess or manage users' private keys, recovery phrases, or digital assets. Users bear ultimate responsibility for managing and utilizing their digital assets.

Article 3 (AI Analysis and Strategy Execution)
AI-based market analysis, information provision, and strategy execution provided by the Service are intended as technical support only. They do not constitute investment advice, investment solicitation, or any guarantee of future profits. Users acknowledge that losses may occur due to market conditions, price fluctuations, liquidity issues, or other factors.

Article 4 (Operation Modes)
Users may select and use the following modes within the Service.
· Active Mode: Users can review AI-supported information and make their own decisions regarding strategy selection or approval.

Article 5 (Connected Asset Range and Monthly Usage Limits)
The Service applies monthly usage limits based on the range of digital assets connected by the user. Specific conditions, applicable ranges, and service specifications shall be displayed within the Service or in separate explanatory materials.

Article 6 (Risk Management and Service Restrictions)
The Company may suspend or restrict AI-based strategy execution when deemed necessary based on market conditions, liquidity, price volatility, or other risk factors.

Article 7 (Service Fees and Network Costs)
Service fees shall be determined separately within the Service. Users are responsible for blockchain network fees (gas fees), external service fees, and other costs associated with transactions.

Article 8 (Disclaimer)
The Company does not guarantee any profits, returns, or increases in asset value resulting from the use of the Service. The Company shall not be liable, to the extent permitted by applicable laws, for damages arising from market fluctuations, blockchain network failures, failures of external services, smart contract vulnerabilities, unauthorized access by third parties, or other circumstances beyond the Company's reasonable control.

Article 9 (Prohibited Activities)
Users shall not engage in the following activities:
· Unauthorized access to the Service
· Attacks against or interference with the Service systems
· Reverse engineering of the Service
· Violating the rights of other users or third parties
· Activities that violate applicable laws or public order and morals

Article 10 (Account Deletion)
Users may delete their accounts at any time through Account > Delete Account within the Service. Before deleting their account, users should confirm the status of digital assets held within their personal wallets. After account deletion, access to the Service will be terminated, and certain records or settings may not be recoverable.

Article 11 (Amendments to the Terms)
The Company may amend these Terms when necessary due to changes in the Service, legal requirements, or other reasonable circumstances. In the event of significant changes, users will be notified through in-service notifications or other appropriate methods.

Help.pageSubtitle: Frequently asked questions about Ultra AutoTrade

faqs.item1Answer: Health Factor is a safety metric for collateral in Aave. If it falls below 1.0, liquidation risk arises. Our system automatically manages it to stay at 1.6 or above.
faqs.item2Question: What happens if HF drops below 1.6?
faqs.item2Answer: The system switches to SAFE_MODE and halts new deposits. If necessary, positions are automatically reduced. If HF falls below 1.3, HARD_STOP (full withdrawal) is triggered.
faqs.item3Question: What should I do if an emergency stop is triggered?
faqs.item3Answer: All automated trading stops. Your funds remain safely held in Aave. An administrator will review the situation and manually resume operations. No action is required from the user.
faqs.item4Answer: The USDC supply rate on Aave fluctuates based on market supply and demand. When borrowing demand decreases, the rate drops. The AI monitors market conditions and aims to operate at the optimal timing.
faqs.item5Question: What should I do if I want to stop using the service?
faqs.item5Answer: Please contact the administrator. They will handle the withdrawal from Aave. Your funds will be returned to your wallet.
faqs.item6Question: How often does the AI make decisions?
faqs.item6Answer: Market analysis and decisions are performed automatically every 4 hours. You can check the results on the dashboard.
faqs.item7Question: Is there a deadline for approving trades?
faqs.item7Answer: In active mode, please approve or reject AI proposals within 1 hour. Requests will be automatically cancelled on timeout.
faqs.item8Question: What is the minimum investment amount?
faqs.item8Answer: A minimum deposit of $200 in USDC is required to start auto-trading. Auto-trading will not start with a balance below $200.
faqs.item9Question: What is the difference between testnet and production?
faqs.item9Answer: Testnet uses virtual funds for operational verification. Production uses real USDC. The operation is the same, but gains and losses on testnet do not affect real assets.
faqs.item10Question: Who should I contact if a problem occurs?
faqs.item10Answer: Please contact the Slack #ultra-auto-project channel or the project representative directly. Including a screenshot of the error and steps to reproduce it will help us respond quickly.

Terms.title: Ultra AutoTrade Terms of Service
Terms.section1Body: UAT (Ultra AutoTrade, hereinafter referred to as the "Service") is a digital asset platform that utilizes AI technology to assist users with market analysis and strategy execution. The Service provides an environment where users can utilize digital assets through self-managed wallets. The Service does not guarantee any specific investment results, profits, or preservation of principal.
Terms.section2Body: The Service adopts a Non-Custodial model, meaning users maintain control over their own wallets and digital assets. The Company does not possess or manage users' private keys, recovery phrases, or digital assets. Users bear ultimate responsibility for managing and utilizing their digital assets.
Terms.section3Body: AI-based market analysis, information provision, and strategy execution provided by the Service are intended as technical support only. They do not constitute investment advice, investment solicitation, or any guarantee of future profits. Users acknowledge that losses may occur due to market conditions, price fluctuations, liquidity issues, or other factors.
Terms.section4Intro: Users may select and use the following modes within the Service.
Terms.section4Mode2Body: : Users can review AI-supported information and make their own decisions regarding strategy selection or approval.
Terms.section5Title: Article 5 (Connected Asset Range and Monthly Usage Limits)
Terms.section5Body: The Service applies monthly usage limits based on the range of digital assets connected by the user. Specific conditions, applicable ranges, and service specifications shall be displayed within the Service or in separate explanatory materials.
Terms.section6Body: The Company may suspend or restrict AI-based strategy execution when deemed necessary based on market conditions, liquidity, price volatility, or other risk factors.
Terms.section7Body: The Service is currently free of charge. If service fees are introduced in the future, they will be specified within the Service in advance and applied only with the user's consent. Users are responsible for blockchain network fees (gas fees), external service fees, and other costs associated with transactions.
Terms.section8Body: The Company does not guarantee any profits, returns, or increases in asset value resulting from the use of the Service. The Company shall not be liable, to the extent permitted by applicable laws, for damages arising from market fluctuations, blockchain network failures, failures of external services, smart contract vulnerabilities, unauthorized access by third parties, or other circumstances beyond the Company's reasonable control.
Terms.section9Intro: Users shall not engage in the following activities:
Terms.section9Item2: Attacks against or interference with the Service systems
Terms.section9Item4: Violating the rights of other users or third parties
Terms.section9Item5: Activities that violate applicable laws or public order and morals
Terms.section10Body: Users may delete their accounts at any time through Account > Delete Account within the Service. Before deleting their account, users should confirm the status of digital assets held within their personal wallets. After account deletion, access to the Service will be terminated, and certain records or settings may not be recoverable.
Terms.section11Body: The Company may amend these Terms when necessary due to changes in the Service, legal requirements, or other reasonable circumstances. In the event of significant changes, users will be notified through in-service notifications or other appropriate methods.
